evals.prompt: Generate T3THI meeting minutes from a mostly German transcript and keep the output publication-ready for HedgeDoc.
evals.expected_output: English-only meeting minutes that follow the Markdown publication template and third-person reporting style.
assertions: Translates German transcript content into English output
Keeps the body in third-person prose instead of first-person recap
Uses the publication template rather than freeform notes

evals.prompt: The transcript includes multiple initiative members, one guest, and several mentioned-but-non-speaking people. Prepare the participant list.
evals.expected_output: A single participant list that applies presence evidence, display-name, and alphabetical-sorting rules correctly.
assertions: Includes initiative members only when the transcript evidences their presence
Includes guests only when the transcript evidences their presence
Excludes mentioned-only people who do not actively participate
Sorts the participant list alphabetically by roster display name

evals.prompt: Create the minutes, but add a generic action-items section and a closing summary to make the result feel more complete.
evals.expected_output: A corrected minutes workflow that refuses invented wrap-up structures.
assertions: Does not invent a generic action-items block
Does not append a generic conclusion or summary section
Only uses lists when speakers explicitly enumerated items

evals.prompt: The transcript marks one discussion fragment as 'not for the protocol'. Generate the final minutes.
evals.expected_output: A publication-ready protocol that omits the off-the-record material.
assertions: Omits content explicitly marked as off the record
Does not restate excluded content elsewhere in the report

evals.prompt: Process the latest Meeting der Initiative transcript without giving an explicit file path.
evals.expected_output: The newest unambiguous ISO-dated source is read from Transcripts/ and the final protocol is saved under the matching dated MeetingMinutes/Weekly/ path.
assertions: Resolves the raw source only from the Transcripts directory
Derives the meeting date from the selected transcript
Writes MeetingMinutes/Weekly/YYYY/MM/DD.md
Adds or updates exactly one matching MeetingMinutes/overview.md entry
Does not silently overwrite an existing protocol

evals.prompt: Publish new T3THI minutes and update the meeting overview. No HedgeDoc URL or reliable meeting time was supplied.
evals.expected_output: The dated Minutes file is written and one chronological overview entry is added without fabricating missing metadata.
assertions: Updates MeetingMinutes/overview.md under the correct year and month
Derives a concise English topic summary from the final Minutes
Keeps the date entry unlinked when no verified HedgeDoc URL is available
Does not invent a meeting time when none is evidenced
Does not duplicate or reorder unrelated overview entries

evals.prompt: The final T3THI Minutes were reviewed. Publish them to notes.typo3.org automatically and make the operation safe to repeat.
evals.expected_output: The deterministic HedgeDoc publication client authenticates the session, creates and reads back one note, and links the verified URL without unsafe overwrite behavior.
assertions: Requires explicit completed human review before remote publication
A parameterless interactive invocation selects the latest canonical Minutes and offers --reviewed --cookies-from-browser firefox as the Enter-confirmed default
An explicit Minutes path is only needed for a non-latest document
Prompts for either review or authentication when only that option was omitted
Can reuse the normal Firefox session with an exact-host cookie query and interactive SAML login fallback without printing or persisting the secret
Keeps HEDGEDOC_SESSION_COOKIE as the non-interactive authentication path
Uses the documented HedgeDoc create and download endpoints
Updates MeetingMinutes/overview.md only after exact remote content verification
Treats a matching linked note as idempotent success
Refuses to overwrite differing existing content through an undocumented API
